title: Kenwood kMix £180, Ninja Double Stack £169.99 and a heated throw £53.59
description: Sunday's checked UK deals: the Kenwood kMix stand mixer at its lowest price, a Ninja Double Stack air fryer, and cheap ways to keep warm.
intro:
**Today's standout is the Kenwood kMix stand mixer at £180, the lowest price on PriceSpy's chart and the same as last Black Friday.** Amazon, Argos and John Lewis all charge £180, so buy it wherever suits you. Argos's Black Friday sale has now been running for three days, and the Ninja Double Stack air fryer is down to £169.99 there and at Amazon.

With the clocks gone back, we've added three more ways to keep warm for less: a faux-fur heated throw, an oil-filled radiator and a dehumidifier to stop condensation. Buy now or wait? The kMix, the heated throw and the radiator are at or near their lows, so buy now. The Ninja and the ghd are good prices but have been cheaper, so wait if you can.

deals.name: Kenwood kMix Stand Mixer KMX751ABK, Black
deals.note: The lowest price on PriceSpy's chart, and matched at Argos and John Lewis. Ignore the £359.99 'RRP'; the highest it has really sold for is about £296. Kenwood's own shop still wants £259.99.

deals.name: Silentnight Luxury Ribbed Faux Fur Heated Throw, 120x160cm, Natural
deals.note: Within about £1 of its three-month low, and £21 less than Very charges. A heated throw on the sofa costs pennies an hour, so you can turn the thermostat down.

deals.name: Russell Hobbs RHOFR5002 2000W 9-Fin Oil-Filled Radiator, White
deals.note: Equals its three-month low, and Currys charges the same. Oil-filled radiators keep giving off heat after the thermostat clicks off, which suits a single room you use in the evening.

deals.name: Russell Hobbs Steam Genie 2-in-1 Handheld Steamer 28370
deals.note: Just under its three-month low (£34) and a couple of pounds cheaper than Very and Argos. Handy for shirts and party outfits without getting the ironing board out. Argos's 'was £60' isn't a real recent price.

deals.name: MeacoDry Arete One 10L Dehumidifier
deals.note: A quiet, well-reviewed dehumidifier that also dries washing indoors. £159 matches its lowest price on PriceSpy and Boots charges the same. It's Meaco's normal sale price, so don't expect much lower on Black Friday.

deals.name: Ninja Double Stack Air Fryer 7.6L (SL300UK)
deals.note: Two stacked drawers in the footprint of one, and the same price at Argos. It's been as low as £152.99, so this is a decent price rather than the best. Our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the target prices.

deals.name: ghd Chronos Hair Straightener
deals.note: £77 under ghd's own price and Very. ghd's newest straightener is a popular Christmas present, but expect ghd's own Black Friday sale to match this. See our [ghd Black Friday guide](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

For the kMix, the heated throw, the radiator and the steamer, no: all four are at or below their recent lows. For the Ninja Double Stack and the ghd Chronos, you'll probably see the same or a little less once Ninja and ghd start their own Black Friday sales, so only buy now if you need them. Ninja and Shark's sites still show only a sign-up page today; our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) tracks which retailers have started.

Argos's sale runs until 1 December, and badged items come with a price guarantee to Christmas Day. Our refreshed [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) explains how it works.

## Keep warm for less

Three of today's picks come from this week's [keep warm for less spotlight](/spotlight/keep-warm-for-less-winter-2026/), which compares running costs for blankets, throws, airers and heaters. And if Secret Santa has started at work, our new [Secret Santa gifts under £10 guide](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/) has nine checked ideas.
